scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The CAF-derived TGF-β1–TGFBR–SMAD–CDKN1B/CDKN1A–RB/E2F mechanism is biologically coherent and well grounded, although asserting it as the dominant source of Ki-67 heterogeneity is a testable extrapolation rather than established fact.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: The response explicitly integrates CAF-derived TGFB1, tumor-cell TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3 signaling, p27/p21-mediated CDK inhibition, RB/E2F/FOXM1 suppression, and reduced MKI67 expression into a resolved spatial mechanism. APC/C–Cdh1 turnover and the vessel-distance component remain comparatively isolated from the principal TGF-β niche model. No mechanistic-synthesis ceiling was applied because the central focus-to-target chain and most contextual contributions are explicit and biologically defensible.
